SPAREPARTS FOR TUBE MAKING MACHINE (TET)- SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | MEXICO CITY, MEXICO | 84819090 | 1139669" (BOL no. 1139669, origin India, destination Mexico). Named export buyers with shipment counts: "982 EPL AMERICA, LLC" (Norfolk, USA), "608 EPL AMERICA LLC" (Danville, Virginia, USA), "597 HIMALAYA WELLNESS LLC" (Dubai, UAE), "497 GREEN PLANET INDUSTRIES L.L.C" (Dubai, UAE), "235 ISMAIL ABUDAWOOD AND PROCTER & GAMB" (Dammam, Saudi Arabia). Top export/import port lanes: "NHAVA SHEVA SEA 653", "NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1 463", "Norfolk 301", "SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4 277", "Jebel Ali 236". Source counter: page claims 10702 total shipments; 5 individual dated rows were actually visible on the free view (all dated 2026-02-28, all HS 8481/7326 machine spares to Mexico). Second record set under slug 'essel-propack-limited' (10th Floor, Times Tower, Lower Parel, Mumbai) shows inbound rows only, e.g. "2022-08-17 | BOROUGE PTE LTD | Essel Propack Limited | BORSTAR FB2230 LLD POLYETHYLENE | Jebel Ali, UAE | Nhava Sheva, India | 392455 | AUH200HC9100" — i.e. raw-material imports, not exports.
domestic_evidence: EPL Limited is an Indian listed entity with an active investor-relations disclosure stream on its own site (eplglobal.com/investors), which lists dated SEBI/BSE/NSE filings including "Integrated Filing (Governance) – September 30, 2026", "Outcome of Board Meeting held on October 21, 2026", "Observation Letters with no adverse observations from BSE and NSE", "Regulation 30 - Allotment of equity shares under ESOS 2020 – November 23, 2026" and "Audio Recording of Conference Call held on November 4, 2026". These are statutory filings of a company with ongoing Indian operations and quarterly reporting, i.e. evidence of a live domestic business entity. Domestic manufacturing/supply footprint is also evidenced by the import records of raw material (LLDPE from Borouge via Nhava Sheva, HS 392455) into Indian plants. NOTE: the exact GST turnover band and the India-vs-overseas revenue split were NOT retrieved — the annual report PDF was not opened and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused), so no revenue figure is asserted here.
note: Legal entity: EPL Limited (formerly Essel Propack Limited) — same company, renamed; both names resolve to Indian customs records, so the three names in the input are one entity, not three. Real shipments confirmed on both sides: (a) exports — dated India-origin customs rows to Mexico (BOL 1139669, 2026-02-28) plus named overseas buyers EPL America LLC (USA), Himalaya Wellness LLC and Green Planet Industries LLC (UAE), Ismail Abudawood & P&G (Saudi Arabia) with per-buyer shipment counts; (b) domestic — live listed-company filings and raw-material imports into Indian plants. HS CODE DISCREPANCY (per Rule 3, not a rejection ground): declared HS 392010 (plates/sheets/film of polymers of ethylene) does not match the rows actually seen. The visible export rows are HS 84819090 / 84812000 / 73269099 (valves, taps, machine spares for tube-making lines), and the visible import rows are HS 392455 (LLDPE raw polymer). EPL's core product is laminated/extruded plastic tubes and laminates, which sit under HS 3923 (tubes/pipes of plastics) and 3921 (other plates/sheets/film of plastics) rather than 3920.10 specifically. Verdict per Rule 3: accepted_hs_corrected — company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the factual code(s) 3923/3921 (tubes and laminate film) with 8481/7326 for the machine-spares line, and 3920.10 should not be carried as the declared code. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public on the free views used and not retrieved from the annual report; not invented. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) is a mismatch — EPL is packaging (laminate tubes for beauty, oral care, food, pharma, home care), a polymer-converting manufacturer, not an oil/gas or chemicals trader. Role: manufacturer (own plants, own branded product lines Platina, Platina Pro, r-Platina, NEOSeam, caps & closures, dispensing systems). No sanctions/court/insolvency issues were checked in this pass and none are asserted; per Rule 2 they would not be a rejection ground anyway. Sources used: importkey.com/countries/india/epl-limited, importkey.com/countries/india/essel-propack-limited, eplglobal.com/investors. volza.com returned HTTP 403 (blocked); web_search tool was down for the whole pass, so no second independent shipment aggregator could be cross-checked — the export finding rests on ImportKey alone.
